chapter.heading: Prayer and Praise for Deliverance from EnemiesA Meditation of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite.
chapter.v:
O Lord
my God, in You I put my trust;Save me from all those who persecute me;And deliver me, [Prov. 1:1; 25:1] [Prov. 15:20;]

Lest they
tear me like a lion,Rending me in pieces, while there is none to deliver. [Ps. 49:7; Prov. 11:4; 21:6; Ezek. 7:19; [Luke 12:19, 20] d Dan. 4:27]

O Lord
my God, if I have done this:If there is iniquity in my hands, [Ps. 34:9, 10; 37:25; Prov. 28:25; [Matt. 6:33]]

If I
have repaid evil to him who was at peace with me,Or have plundered my enemy without cause, [Prov. 12:24; 13:4;] [Prov. 19:15]

Let the
enemy pursue me and overtake me;Yes, let him trample my life to the earth,And lay my honor in the dust.Selah [Prov. 19:26] [Prov. 6:8]

Arise, O
Lord, in Your anger;Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies;Rise up for me to the judgment You have commanded!

So the
congregation of the peoples shall surround You;For their sakes, therefore, return on high. [Ps. 112:6; Eccl.]

The Lord
shall judge the peoples;Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness,And according to my integrity within me. [Prov. 10:10]

Oh, let
the wickedness of the wicked come to an end,But establish the just;For the righteous God tests the hearts and minds. [[Ps. 23:4; Prov. 3:23; 28:18; Is.]

My defense
is of God,Who saves the upright in heart. [Ps. 15:5; Prov. 12:3; Matt.]

God is
a just judge,And God is angry with the wicked every day.

If he
does not turn back,He will sharpen His sword;He bends His bow and makes it ready. [Prov. 17:9; [1 Cor. 13:4-7; James 5:20]; 1 Pet. 4:8]

He also
prepares for Himself instruments of death;He makes His arrows into fiery shafts.

Behold, the
wicked brings forth iniquity;Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood. [Prov. 18:7]

He made
a pit and dug it out,And has fallen into the ditch which he made. [Job 31:24; Ps. 52:7; Prov. 18:11; [1 Tim. 6:17]]

His trouble
shall return upon his own head,And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown. [Prov. 6:23]

I will
praise the Lord according to His righteousness,And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
